desc: Welcome to 35-45 May Street, New Rochelle's choice for classic, spacious, elevator apartments. Professionally owner-managed, our apartment homes will meet all your needs: comfort, convenience, and location. May Street is a quiet lane near the intersection of Lockwood and North Avenues, around the corner from Sound Shore Medical Center, one mile from Iona College and a short walk to the Metro North Railroad, which will bring you to Manhattan's Grand Central Station in under 30 minutes! Our beautifully renovated apartment homes feature hardwood floors, spacious layouts, and eat-in kitchens with solid oak cabinets. Higher floor units in this elevator building offer expansive views and great light. Our professional management team and on-site maintenance staff will keep your apartment in tip-top shape. We look forward to seeing you at 35-45 May!

desc: The Huguenot is a new property located in the heart of downtown New Rochelle that doesn't nickel and dime its residents! Offering spacious studio, 1 bedroom, and 2 bedroom apartments that are designed with modern living in mind, each apartment is elegantly finished with hardwood floors, a full suite of Blomberg stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and in-unit washer/dryers. Amenities include a rooftop terrace, lounge spaces, fitness room with Echelon connected equipment, and secure package locker system. Pets are welcome and will appreciate the pet spa and rooftop dog run. The Huguenot is just a few blocks from Metro North and Amtrak, and is ideally positioned for residents seeking a modern apartment, with ease of access to all that this vibrant city has to offer.

desc:
Welcome to The Atelier, an exquisite affordable new development in the heart of charming New Rochelle. The Atelier offers all the amenities of modern living within a quaint and historic setting that has historically been home to a significant number of prominent 20th-century illustrators. Inquire today and discover high-quality, affordable housing crafted to inspire your journey.

 

The Atelier is part of Westchester Place, three buildings totaling 524 units in downtown New Rochelle. The community provides bespoke housing at affordable rates, art galleries and studios (including a communal studio free of charge) and thousands of square feet of art related event spaces.

Discover elevated living at Alary, where modern luxury meets everyday convenience in the heart of New Rochelle, Westchester County NY. Designed for today's lifestyle, Alary offers thoughtfully crafted studio, one-, and two-bedroom residences featuring spacious layouts, contemporary finishes, oversized windows, in-home washer and dryer, and designer kitchens with stainless steel appliances and quartz countertops.

Located just minutes from Metro-North, Alary offers a quick commute to Manhattan while placing you steps from New Rochelle's vibrant dining, shopping, waterfront, and entertainment destinations.

desc:
Arc House - A 17-story New Development, offers luxury apartments in New Rochelle near NYC, perfect for young
professionals looking for a stylish yet homey place to live. Choose from spacious
studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments featuring floor-to-ceiling windows framing
stunning Long Island Sound views, private balconies, chef-inspired kitchens with
islands, European stainless steel appliances, spa-style baths, and in-unit laundry. Our
pet-friendly community spans two full floors of amenities, including indoor and outdoor
dog runs, a state-of-the-art fitness center with a dedicated gym terrace, a Pickleball court, a basketball court,
coworking spaces, and social lounges. Enjoy a fully landscaped rooftop with skyline
views, plus an outdoor BBQ terrace ideal for relaxing or entertaining. Located in
downtown New Rochelle, Arc House surrounds you with boutique dining, coffee shops,
local art galleries, and waterfront parks all just steps from the Metro-North station for a
seamless 30-minute commute to Manhattan. Among the most desirable apartments in
Westchester, Arc House combines city energy with suburban ease for the ultimate
lifestyle. Explore life in full color at Arc House.

Welcome to Seven Pines Tower, a Unique and Bold residential 27 story high-rise located along the Hudson River in Yonkers, New York which is just minutes to midtown NYC. Just 1 block from our front entrance is the Glenwood Ave Metro-North Station which is only 28 minutes to NYC's Grand Central Station. Our location is also around the corner from the newly envisioned Trevor Park which includes a playground, basketball and tennis courts. Many of Yonkers attractions like JFK Marina and Park, the Hudson River Museum and Planetarium along with Empire Casino and Raceway are all a short distance away.
Seven Pines Tower is designed with many homes offering spectacular views of the historic Hudson River, from NYC's George Washington Bridge to the newly constructed Cuomo Bridge. We offer over-sized 1 bedroom and 2-Bedroom apartments many with private balcony spaces. Our on-site management and maintenance team are what sets Seven Pines apart. Our 24-hour front desk staff is friendly and vigilant, stationed in the towers recently renovated lobby. Our on-site Fitness Center and Laundry Room are conveniently located within the building along with indoor/outdoor parking for all your driving needs.

desc: Inspired by the scenic Hudson Valley Region, Hudson Park offers resort-like apartment living just minutes from Manhattan. Showcasing urbane living in a sought-after urban location minutes from NYC, Hudson Park is perched at the edge of the Hudson River, with courtyards and waterfront promenades offering breathtaking views of the Manhattan skyline and the New Jersey Palisades. Our apartments feature 9 -10 foot ceilings, walk-in closets, granite countertops, plush floors, and oversized windows that flood your apartment with sunlight. Amenities include a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, and coffee shop, and we're just steps from Metro North. With Hudson Park North, Hudson Park South, and River Club all included in our community, we offer multiple floorplan options at various price points. River Club is our most luxurious offering with exclusive amenities. With studio, 1- and 2-bedroom unit options, schedule your tour today so we can help you find your perfect home!

desc:
Hudson Blue blends contemporary design with cutting edge style to set a new standard of luxury living. Residents will enjoy our various best-in-class amenities for a top luxury-living experience. Blue lets you live modern, with apartments that give you all the pleasures of home with none of the hassles of ownership. It's the features you want and the freedom to enjoy them.

Every Blue building is unique in that each one has a different theme base on the location. And everyone is the same in that they're completely renovated, close to everything the city dweller needs, and run with utter respect for every resident. Blue brings an unparalleled lifestyle of convenience and amenity-rich living; one designed to delight, surprise and surpass expectations. An unmatched lifestyle of convenience and amenity-rich living awaits you.

desc:
Alexander Crossing provides exquisite style in a vibrant setting. Select your dream home from one of our stylish apartments with open floor plans, gourmet kitchens with stainless steel GE appliances, quartz countertops, moveable islands (in many homes) and full size in-unit washer and dryers. Enjoy a collection of curated amenities with high-end features to level up your downtime. Ditch the gym membership and flex your muscles in our spacious fitness center with state-of-the-art exercise equipment, on-demand classes, and Hudson River views. Or, when the day calls for something more relaxing, take a dip in the outdoor heated pool while watching the sun set over the Hudson. Work from home without leaving home in our 2 story social lounge and co-working space. Inside and out, Alexander Crossing has everything to take your at-home lifestyle to a whole new level.

desc:
Introducing Hudson 44, Yonkers' newest and tallest luxury rental building that rises 25 stories over the Hudson River, offering breathtaking views, refined residences, and an unmatched amenity experience.

Residences Designed for Light, Space & Comfort
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame sweeping river and skyline vistas, while white oak floors, quartz kitchens, and spa-inspired baths create an atmosphere of quiet luxury. Each home includes an in-unit washer/dryer, climate control, and smart, sustainable finishes.

Amenities on a Grand Scale
From the 25th-floor Sky Lounge with a heated rooftop pool, coworking spaces, yoga studio, fitness center, and panoramic terraces to the concierge-attended lobby, EV-ready parking, bike storage, and coffee bar, Hudson 44 offers a lifestyle where everything flows with ease.

Where the Hudson Meets the City
 In the heart of Downtown Yonkers, you're moments from parks, dining, culture, and the Metro-North arrive at Grand Central in under 30 minutes.

Highlights:
 Studio to 3-bedroom residences
 Floor-to-ceiling windows with river views
 Heated rooftop pool & wellness spaces
 Co-working lounge & private event room
 Doorman-attended lobby & package room
 Indoor self-park garage with EV charging
 Minutes to the Metro-North, dining, and riverfront

desc:
Welcome to Crestwood Lake Apartments, a peaceful Yonkers community where tree-lined streets, open green space, and a warm neighborhood feel make coming home easy. Spacious apartment homes offer expansive layouts, sunlit rooms, and thoughtful finishes designed for comfortable everyday living.

Set across 60 acres, Crestwood Lake invites residents to slow down and enjoy the outdoors with winding streets and walkways, wide-open lawns, playgrounds, and a tranquil private lake. On-site laundry rooms, plentiful parking options including free surface lots and street parking, plus private garages available for rent and school bus stops within the community add everyday convenience.

Located in Northeast Yonkers near Central Avenue, you'll be close to grocery stores, cafes, dining, and daily essentials, as well as Casmir Pulaski Elementary School in nearby Scarsdale. Commuting is simple with quick access to the Bronx River Parkway, Sprain Brook Parkway, and I-87. Crestwood Metro-North Station is just a short drive away, with express service to Grand Central Terminal in approximately 30 minutes, while nearby bus routes include the BxM4 express to Fifth Avenue and the 20/21 line. Discover the space, comfort, and connection that make Crestwood Lake feel like home.

desc:
Introducing Miroza Tower III at 601 Ridge Hill Boulevard. Perched atop one of Yonker's seven hills, Miroza at Ridge Hill is ideally located 30 minutes from midtown Manhattan and offers a 24-hour concierge as well as a convenient shuttle to Metro North. Miroza is next door to the acclaimed Ridge Hill shopping center, a veritable shopping mecca with stores like Whole Foods, The Apple Store, H&M, and the Legoland Discovery Center (to name just a few). You're just a quick ride to downtown Yonkers, with its many boutiques, galleries, restaurants, and scenic waterfront. Discover cultural gems like the stunning Untermyer Gardens Conservatory, the Hudson River Museum and Planetarium, and the Science Barge.

Each home is brand new, with top-of-line finishes and stylish details including:

- Bright and airy open concept chef's kitchens with breakfast bar
- Stainless steel appliance package that includes dishwashers and microwaves
- Washer/dryers standard in each unit
- Sleek designer bathrooms with deep soaking tubs
- Double paned, extra large windows (some floor to ceiling) that reveal blue sky and bring in extra sunshine
- Stunning hardwood floors throughout
- Split systems for heating and cooling that you control
- Select units feature terraces and stunning western views - ideal perches for relaxing, entertaining, and convening with the natural landscape.

Our one-of-a-kind amenities center is a stand-alone complex that houses a variety of recreational activities:
- All-season indoor pool, sauna, and hot tub
- Indoor basketball court, fully-equipped gym and running track
- Resident lounge with bar and kitchen
- Children's playroom and screening room
- Outdoor patio / lounge with scenic overlook

Come see why Yonker's is NYC's 6th borough!

Pricing may reflect a net price with concessions.

desc:
Named Wood Works to pay homage to the properties previous use, the Port Chester Lumber Yard operated here for 60 years. 
This quiet, private, 36-unit boutique community is the first building built in downtown Harrison in over 30 years, and features contemporary design. 
The one-of-a-kind 5,100sqft rooftop lounge is complete with a bar area, lounge furniture, barbecues, and outdoor television. Altogether, a terrific environment for entertaining. Additional amenities include, common fitness, and virtual doorman secured entry system which allows you app access to see and provide entry for your guests remotely. 
Each apartment home features quartz counter tops, modern tiled bathrooms, stainless steel appliances, and a washer/dryer in every unit.

FEATURES:
Custom kitchens
Ceasarstone countertops
Large bathrooms
Roof deck
Covered parking
Hardwood Flooring
Washer/Dryer in your unit
Elevator
Stainless Steel Appliances

desc: 1 Martine is the new luxury rental that is part of City Square, an art-inspired reinvention of an entire city block with a private park at its center! Located in downtown White Plains, just steps from the Metro-North Station, 1 Martine offers the region's most distinctive apartments, featuring 11 foot ceilings, exposed ductwork and track lit gallery walls that creates a Soho vibe... unexpectedly found in Westchester.Amenities include a dramatic Double Height Lobby with 24/7 Concierge, Fitness Center, Conferecne Room, Stadium Seating Screening Room with adjacent Party Room, Game Room, Club Lounge with Skyline Deck and Art everywhere!And only City Square Central Park offers its own private oasis in the heart of the city, featuring a Fountain Sun Deck, BBQ Stations with Outdoor Dining, a Putting Green, Walking Track with Exercise Stations, lush Landscaping and City Square Cafe.Experience life at 1 Martine in White Plains and all of the restaurants, shopping and entertainment that this walkable live/work/play city has to offer.

desc:
Continuum offers studios, one bedroom, and two bedroom luxury residences that reflect your distinct tastes. Set at the foot of the Metro North railroad station, Continuum offers modern sophistication and luxurious amenities, from a stylish sky lounge to an elegant poolside terrace. Imagine being moments from Manhattan via express train and moments from vibrant shops, restaurants, and rooftop bars right here in White Plains. When you live at Continuum, you live connected.

Floor plans are artist's rendering. All dimensions are approximate. Actual product and specifications may vary in dimension or detail. Not all features are available in every rental home. Please see a representative for details.

desc:
Now pre-leasing! The Magnolia brings 223 hospitality inspired residences to downtown Port Chester. Each residence has been thoughtfully curated with a wide range of floorplans including studios, junior one-bedrooms, one-bedrooms, one-bedrooms with dens, and several types of two-bedrooms. 

Amenities include a roof deck overlooking the Long Island Sound and southern views of NYC skyline, fully equipped fitness center with separate fitness studio, elegant resident lounge and a hotel-like lobby complete with coffee bar. There is onsite parking, bike storage and a professional onsite management team. 

Outside, everything is at your doorstep - The Capital Theatre is across the street, The Metro North is a 1 minute walk, 50 minutes to Grand Central. Convenient shopping at the Waterfront at Port Chester (Costco, Stop & Shop, AMC Port Chester 14), fantastic dining around the corner: bartaco, Talia, Felice, Colony Grill, Five Iron Golf, and The Kneaded Bread are all within the village core, and Rye Town Park and Oakland Beach are a short drive away.

The Magnolia is a one of a kind experience delivering the very best of Port Chester.

desc: No Broker Fee. Wake up on the water at The Mariner and live the life you've always dreamed of. No one has the apartment space, location or Concierge level services that we offer in Porchester. Gas stoves in every apt of course! Experience waterfront luxury in the heart of it all with just a five minute walk to the Metro North train. No broker or mounting costs such as amenities fees or sewer, water, trash fees. Just parking and pets are extra. Get your morning exercise in our free stylish fitness center or take it outside for a jog with your dog on the nearby River Trail. In the afternoon take your boat out from one of our many boat slips or rent one from just across the way. Join the daily fishing Charter that leaves from our dock. At night visit one of Port Chester's upscale outdoor riverside restaurants such as Colony Grill or the legendary Bar Taco right at our door step. When you want to get out and explore, the beaches of Rye and Greenwich are just next door. During fall/winter they even let your dog run off leash. The Mariner is a full service, luxury rental building. In addition to free on-site fitness, residents also enjoy concierge, covered parking, penthouse level club lounge, on-site storage, dry cleaning services and we are pet friendly. All residences are spacious with high end finishes, appliances and details. Each has an in unit washer/dryer and is cable ready for both Optimum and Fios. Many have large walk in closets. Residents can relax at the end of a long day on our landscaped roof deck complete with bbq area and spectacular harbor views and Friday night fireworks. Come live life to the fullest at The Mariner your waterfront escape.

desc: Welcome to 30 Broad a brand-new collection of studios and one-bedrooms rising at 30 Broad Street, in the middle of everything downtown Port Chester has become. It's a piece of the block: a modern building with a vintage soul, set on a heritage brick base and anchored by Run & Hide Brewing Co. The building takes its name from Janis Joplin, who played the Capitol Theatre the 1926 "Original Rock Palace" just steps away. Inside, the homes are built to last and made for light: quartz counters, stainless appliances, spa-tiled baths, wide-plank floors, soft-close cabinetry, in-unit washer and dryer, and smart-lock entry. Windows frame the town skyline. Everything is solid, quiet, and yours.

desc:
** NO MONTH TO MONTH OPTIONS AVAILABLE**

 Wave Goodbye to Mounting Fees & Parking Hassles! Parking ranges from just $64 to $140 a month! Just parking and pets are extra plus a flat rate for utilities. (video of apt 207 in this ad!)

Enjoy living at an ALL-NEW boutique residence offering a stylish, loft like feel in downtown White Plains' most coveted location.

Promos: Waived amenity fee for the first 12 months!

$750 security with 750 credit! Half month security with aprox. 680+ credit. Standard 1 month with scores below 650. 

Unbeatable Location:
Step outside your door to enjoy the best shopping, outdoor dining, live music, and entertainment the city has to offer. Plus, you're just a few blocks from the Metro-North station, where a 39-minute express train takes you straight to NYC.

 Amenities: The Azzure features a brand-new 1,200 sq. ft. fitness center & Pet Spa,, tenant lounge, gaming areas, work/conference room, yoga studio all free and ready for residents. 

Pet-Friendly Living:
At The Azzure, pets are family. In addition to our spacious new Pet Spa coming soon, you'll find doggy daycares nearby.

Convenient Parking & Easy Access:
Enjoy plentiful parking at the adjacent City Center garage for just $140/month. Only $64 a month if you are out by 8 in after 6pm with leaving the car full weekends included. With no parking spot limits, parking is hassle-free. Plus, you'll have easy access to all major highways for smooth commuting.

Flat rate for heat and AC for limited time:
No mounting water, trash, sewer, broker or admin fees. For a limited time, tenants pay a monthly flat rate for electric which includes heat and central AC. Studios pay $125 month, 1 bedrooms $165 a month and 2 bedrooms $210 a month. We are wired for Verizon Fios for cable/wireless which would be the only additional utility cost.

desc: Welcome to The Altos (formerly known as Avalon White Plains), where elevated living meets unmatched convenience in Downtown White Plains. Our luxury apartment community offers studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom homes with gourmet kitchens, private terraces, in-unit washers/dryers, and modern finishes. Located just blocks from White Plains Metro-North station, enjoy seamless access to NYC while surrounded by vibrant dining, shopping, and entertainment. World-class amenities include a resort-style pool, 24-hour fitness center, resident lounge, concierge service, garage parking, and Amazon HUB package lockers. Our pet-friendly community features sustainable design with ENERGY STAR appliances. From our passionate team dedicated to exceptional service to our prime Westchester location, The Altos puts everything within reach. This is apartment living reimagined, where home rises to the lifestyle you've earned. Experience modern comfort in a community designed for how you live today.

desc:
Experience the pinnacle of luxury living at One Lyon Place in White Plains, NY! Our brand-new, upscale apartments are now pre-leasing. Situated just half a block from top dining spots and around the corner from vibrant local attractions, One Lyon offers a lifestyle of unparalleled convenience and elegance.

Our residences range from stylish studios to spacious two-bedroom units, each designed with premium finishes and modern amenities. Enjoy in-unit washers and dryers, a state-of-the-art fitness center and yoga retreat, a rooftop deck with outdoor pool, and many more. The ground floor hosts to fantastic retail spaces, bringing additional convenience right to your doorstep 

White Plains itself is a vibrant city with plenty to offer. Just a short walk from One Lyon Place, you'll find an array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. Visit The Westchester, a premier shopping destination, or explore the White Plains Farmers Market for fresh local produce. Enjoy a day at the nearby Saxon Woods Park, complete with hiking trails and a swimming pool, or catch a show at the White Plains Performing Arts Center.

Discover the perfect blend of luxury and location at One Lyon Place. Schedule a tour today and make your next greatest memory in your new home.

desc: Admirals Cove is GDC's newest luxury rental community on the Hudson River. Set on the Haverstraw Waterfront Park & Sculpture Trail, four boutique buildings sit on a peninsula with spectacular views of the river at its widest point. Featuring four boutique buildings with waterfront-inspired contemporary architecture, each offers a variety of studios; 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartments with market-leading fixtures and finishes. Amazing amenities include Club Lounges, Fitness Centers in each building, a Pool & Cabana, two BBQ pavilions, a Marina and Kayak Launch, Playground, and more... all just steps away from the NY Waterways Commuter Ferry to the Ossining Metro-North Train Station.

Rockland Commons provides oversized 1- and 2-bedroom apartments that feature gleaming hardwood flooring, 8-foot ceilings, modern kitchens and baths, walk-in closets and so much more!

Appreciate an easy commute to the Palisades Parkway and NYS Thruway, with under an hour commute to NYC.

Come and see, one visit will convince you that your next address should be at Rockland Commons!

desc:
Welcomes active seniors 55 and over to a beautiful garden apartment community overlooking the Hudson River in Westchester County.

Springvale offers outstanding housing value with both social opportunities and privacy.

Why Live at Springvale?
Community Clubhouse (The Barn)
Clubs and activities
Close proximity to shopping
Transportation services provided
24 hour maintenance
Spacious apartments
Independent living in a beautiful park-like setting
All apartments have their own private entrances
Parking spots available

Springvale is located in Westchester County, New York, on some of the most desirable real estate in the country. Overlooking the Hudson River in the Town of Cortlandt, the Springvale community includes 31 buildings sitting on 35 acres of park-like grounds with river views and old growth trees.

Our garden apartments, with private entrances, offer residents opportunities for social interaction, quite leisure, and personal privacy. Beautiful Oscawana Park hiking trails are located adjacent to the Springvale property. Many of our residents explore the remains of the McAndrews Estate, a grand 75 acre estate inside of Oscawana Park.

Springvale Apartments provides spacious public rooms in which to gather, including The Barn, a beautiful activities center, consisting of an activities room with a library, large screen TV, comfortable seating and kitchen, and an exercise studio.

Springvale provides free bus transportation for shopping every Tuesday and Friday.

As apartments become available for rent, Springvale inspects them and undertakes improvements as necessary.

A select group of apartments are being renovated and redesigned with enhanced kitchen and bathroom facilities including new cabinets, granite counter tops, larger modern stoves and refrigerators, and recessed lighting. These redesigned apartments are available for rent at a modest surcharge over the price of our standard offerings.

desc:
Tower Ridge Grande: Luxury Living in the Heart of Orange County Tower Ridge Grande sets a new standard for refined living in Scotchtown, a desirable enclave of Middletown, NY. This upscale apartment community blends elegant design with resort-style amenities, offering a lifestyle of comfort, convenience, and sophistication. Each spacious residence is thoughtfully designed with gourmet kitchens featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, rich wood cabinetry, and Kohler fixtures. Wide-plank oak-style luxury vinyl flooring adds warmth and character throughout, while porcelain-tiled bathrooms are outfitted with granite-topped vanities, double sinks, and walk-in showers. Every unit includes a full-size washer and dryer, recessed LED lighting, and energy-efficient gas heating and central air conditioning. Many apartments offer private entrances, balconies, or decks for enjoying peaceful surroundings. At Tower Ridge Grande, residents enjoy access to a professionally equipped fitness center with a cardio deck and strength training circuit, a sparkling outdoor swimming pool, and a regulation-size tennis court. The elegant clubhouse includes locker rooms and a resident lounge ideal for relaxing or socializing. Each unit is assigned two convenient parking spaces. Ideally located at 200 Tower Drive in Middletown, NY, Tower Ridge Grande offers easy access to local shopping, fine dining, entertainment, State Route 17, State Highway 211, Interstate Route 87.

Stevens Manor is conveniently located near commuter busses, the train station, and major highways, like the Taconic and I-84, shopping and dining, health care facilities like Garnet Health Medical Center, and educational institutions like SUNY Orange. 

Stevens Manor is a community where respect and courtesy are encouraged, and we look forward to welcoming you home!

Enjoy easy access to local restaurants, shops, hiking trails in the Hudson Highlands, and the Cold Spring Metro-North train station, offering convenient transportation to New York City.

desc:
Live Where Good Grows.

The Leaf stands tall in the heart of New Rochelle, a 26-story haven where your narrative takes a bold turn. Our homage to seamless sophistication sets the tone for your story, and you're invited to bring the outdoors in. You'll be captivated by modern interiors, striking amenities that pop with organic hues-like our lush courtyard-and innovative details that create a revitalizing ambiance. You're also a heartbeat away from all the fun in New York City.

desc:
Two Clinton Park offers an exceptional living experience with stunning views, thoughtfully curated modern interiors, and impeccable services. Residents enjoy exclusive access to incredible indoor and outdoor amenities, all within a dynamic downtown neighborhood and steps from the waterfront. It's the perfect place to call home. Explore our studio to 3-bedroom luxury residences in New Rochelle today.

This information is a general overview of potential costs. For a complete list of fees, visit our property website. Prices are subject to change and may vary based on move-in date and lease term. Some apartment homes may require prequalification if required by any applicable affordability program. Standard security deposit subject to change based on screening results; total security deposit(s) will not exceed any maximum prescribed by applicable law. Resident may be responsible for maintaining insurance or covering related costs. Some fees may not apply to apartment homes receiving subsidies or subject to an affordability program. Resident is responsible for damages that exceed ordinary wear and tear. Some items may be taxed under applicable law. This form does not modify the lease, and all fees are subject to the lease. Additional fees may apply as detailed in the lease. A sample lease may be requested prior to application. Residents may be responsible for utilities and related fees, per the lease. Lease terms and available options are subject to change and may vary based on apartment home availability and any applicable program requirements. In the event of any informational conflict, the lease governs.

desc:
Sawyer Place redefines luxury living with stunning Hudson River and city views. The thoughtfully designed studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences offer spacious layouts that seamlessly combine modern sophistication and comfort. Enjoy an impressive array of amenities, including a top-tier fitness center with Pelotons, group classes, and a Water Rower, along with spaces for unwinding like the expansive lounge. The sundeck provides a picture-perfect spot for leisure, in combination with an outdoor movie screen that creates a unique entertainment experience. Step inside to an additional theater, further adding to the exceptional offerings of this remarkable community. 

Applicants should demonstrate a rent-to-income ratio of approximately 40% or less and a screening that includes credit, criminal, rental history, ID verification, and income verification, which will require uploading identification and linking financial accounts; timelines can vary depending on completion of applicant-required steps.
